content.short: Blockchain at Davis promotes education, research, and development in blockchain technology.
content.description: Blockchain at Davis is a student-run community at UC Davis that helps undergraduates and graduate students explore blockchain technology and its real-world uses. The group hosts events, workshops, and activities designed to build foundational knowledge and practical skills, from smart contracts to decentralized applications. Members can connect with industry professionals, researchers, and peers, exchange ideas, and collaborate on projects. Through accessible resources and ongoing learning opportunities, participants deepen their understanding of blockchain concepts, applications, and implications.
